about: Social standing (Docs/Design/49-characters-and-earned-gifts.md, Design 7): the social level curve, its titles, and which receipts count as social XP. A level is the account's social XP (summed over its characters) on this curve: level L to L + 1 costs stepBase + stepGrowth × (L − 1). Every number is a placeholder for the user's balance pass.

unlocks.about: Earned Gift tiers, per account (doc 49, 9; the user's measures, 2026-10-06). Kept once earned.
